description: Two safe local OpenAI Agents descriptor fixtures that test exact static tool-label comparison against an explicitly supplied TrustWeave manifest.
non_claim: This benchmark compares supplied static labels only. It does not import or execute a framework, inspect application source, authenticate the inputs, establish runtime reachability, or prove either declaration is complete.

cases.title: Complete declared tool surface
cases.rationale: The supplied descriptor and supplied manifest use the same three exact static tool labels, providing a clear control for the bounded comparison.
cases.non_claim: A complete label comparison does not prove that the supplied inputs represent the executable application or its reachable runtime behavior.

cases.title: Undeclared external-capable tool label
cases.rationale: The supplied descriptor adds one static tool label that is absent from the supplied manifest, so the bounded comparison records a declaration mismatch for human review.
cases.non_claim: The mismatch does not prove a live tool exists, that it is reachable, or that it is insecure; it only shows disagreement between the supplied local inputs.
